name: USO Peeling Width
definition: For an ample class $C$, minimize over all unique-sink orientations $o$ of its one-inclusion graph the largest cardinality of a strongly connected component of $o$. Set $\nu(C)=\infty$ when $C$ has no unique-sink orientation.
normalization: Strongly connected components are counted by concepts. The minimum ranges over the CCMW unique-sink orientations intrinsic to the cubes of $C$.
comments: Width one is dismantlability; finite width is existence of a representation map. This invariant controls source-component deletion along one representation orientation.
